bug_semantics: During ZIP extraction, a local attacker able to mutate the extraction directory can replace an already-validated parent directory with a symlink before OpenClaw opens the destination pathname. The later pathname-based write follows the rebound parent and can create or truncate a file outside the extraction root with the OpenClaw process's privileges; leaf-only O_NOFOLLOW protection does not bind mutable parent traversal to the checked directory identity.
flaw_origin: Original feature implementation. Commit 3a6ee5ee00176c88aee32bb8bfd543780014c079 first added the production ZIP extractor in src/infra/archive.ts with a lexical path.resolve/string-prefix containment check followed by separate mkdir, asynchronous ZIP decoding, and fs.writeFile(outPath, data). That check/use separation created the parent-symlink TOCTOU window at inception; later streaming and partial symlink-hardening changes retained the same mutable-parent pathname resolution and are not origins.
evidence: The assigned first-party advisory GHSA-r54r-wmmq-mh84 identifies the parent-directory symlink-rebind TOCTOU in src/infra/archive.ts, affected npm versions <= 2026.3.1, first patched version 2026.3.2, and direct fix 7dac9b05dd9d38dd3929637f26fa356fd8bdd107.

numactl --cpunodebind=1 --membind=1 git show --format=fuller --no-ext-diff --no-renames 3a6ee5ee00176c88aee32bb8bfd543780014c079 -- src/infra/archive.ts shows the file added from /dev/null and the exact vulnerable sequence: resolve the entry beneath destDir, test startsWith(destDir), mkdir the parent, await entry.async('nodebuffer'), then fs.writeFile(outPath, data).

numactl --cpunodebind=1 --membind=1 git log --all --reverse -S'await fs.writeFile(outPath, data)' -- src/infra/archive.ts reports 3a6ee5ee00176c88aee32bb8bfd543780014c079 as the addition and d3ee5deb87ee2ad0ab83c92c365611165423cb71 only as its later streaming rewrite, establishing the smallest line-origin BIC rather than a later refactor.

Move/import rejection and direct-parent check: git diff-tree -r -M -C --name-status 5dc87a2ed4cf8bff1c76cddb2a1de76d333f4cc4 3a6ee5ee00176c88aee32bb8bfd543780014c079 -- src/infra/archive.ts reports A, while git cat-file -e 5dc87a2ed4cf8bff1c76cddb2a1de76d333f4cc4:src/infra/archive.ts fails because the path is absent. A parent-tree git grep for JSZip, extractZip, entry.async, and writeFile(outPath finds JSZip only in media tests and no prior production ZIP extractor, rejecting an in-repository move or import of the vulnerable implementation.

Aggregate/decomposition rejection: the raw git cat-file commit object for 3a6ee5ee00176c88aee32bb8bfd543780014c079 has exactly one parent, 5dc87a2ed4cf8bff1c76cddb2a1de76d333f4cc4, and only the subject 'feat: unify hooks installs and webhooks' with no body, merge parents, member SHAs, or decomposition metadata. The vulnerable lines are directly introduced by this ordinary commit, so squash_decomposed is false and decomposed_shas is empty.

Version boundary: git tag --contains 3a6ee5ee00176c88aee32bb8bfd543780014c079 --list v2026.1.15 v2026.1.16-2 prints only v2026.1.16-2. git rev-parse resolves v2026.3.1 and v2026.3.2 to d76b224e20c790b7223d4075abd087c9576a4661 and 85377a28175695c224f6589eb5c1460841ecd65c; merge-base --is-ancestor confirms the BIC is in v2026.3.1, the fix is not in v2026.3.1, and the fix is in v2026.3.2.

Direct-fix verification: git show 7dac9b05dd9d38dd3929637f26fa356fd8bdd107 -- src/infra/archive.ts src/infra/fs-safe.ts src/infra/archive.test.ts removes truncate-on-open, opens without O_TRUNC or creates exclusively, verifies the opened handle's file identity and real path remain inside the destination, truncates only after those checks, writes through that verified handle, and adds a parent-rebind regression that preserves the outside target as SAFE.

Disputed marker_state resolution: numactl --cpunodebind=1 --membind=1 git cat-file commit 3a6ee5ee00176c88aee32bb8bfd543780014c079 shows human author and committer Peter Steinberger <steipete@gmail.com>, one parent, and only the subject 'feat: unify hooks installs and webhooks'. There is no commit body, Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, AI trailer, bot identity, or other AI marker. No PR, branch, later commit, or fix metadata is used.
reasoning: Both audits agreed on the vulnerability, smallest BIC, immediate-parent absence, non-aggregate status, fix, version boundary, and NOT_AI outcome; they disagreed only on marker_state. The reviewer wins that field: ai_marker records an observed BIC commit-object marker, so it must be null when the raw commit object contains none. The primary's statement that the marker is absent was evidentially correct, but storing an explanatory 'absent: ...' sentence as a non-null marker conflates evidence of absence with a marker and is therefore the wrong field state. The explanatory object evidence belongs in evidence and reasoning. Independent Git checks also confirm that 3a6ee5ee00176c88aee32bb8bfd543780014c079 directly added the vulnerable production writer rather than moving, importing, or aggregating an earlier in-repository implementation; its direct parent lacks the path and any equivalent production extractor. The direct fix binds validation to the opened file identity and crosses exactly from the vulnerable v2026.3.1 boundary to patched v2026.3.2. With no AI signal in the BIC object, the gate-complete verdict is NOT_AI.
